config.spv_addon.title: SPV Addon Configuration
text.autoconfig.spv_addon.category.hud: Configure HUD display, colors, and interface elements
text.autoconfig.spv_addon.category.syste: Configure battery, thirst, sanity, and crawling systems (singleplayer only)
spv_addon.config.enableUnifiedHud.toolti: Shows battery, sanity, and thirst as clean text in the top-right corner
spv_addon.config.hudFadeDuration.tooltip: How long HUD elements take to fade in/out (in milliseconds)
spv_addon.config.hudMarginTop.tooltip: Distance from the top of the screen to the HUD
spv_addon.config.hudMarginRight.tooltip: Distance from the right edge of the screen to the HUD
spv_addon.config.hudTextScale.tooltip: Size multiplier for HUD text (1.0 = normal size)
spv_addon.config.hudBackgroundOpacity.to: Transparency of HUD background (0 = invisible, 255 = opaque)
spv_addon.config.hideBelowSanity.tooltip: Hide all HUD elements when sanity drops below this percentage
spv_addon.config.batteryColorPreset.tool: Color scheme for battery indicators (Good/Low/Critical states)
spv_addon.config.sanityColorPreset.toolt: Color scheme for sanity indicators (Good/Low/Critical states)
spv_addon.config.thirstColorPreset.toolt: Color scheme for thirst indicators (Good/Low/Critical states)
spv_addon.config.crawlingColorPreset.too: Color scheme for crawling status indicator
spv_addon.config.enableCrawling.tooltip: Allow players to crawl through tight spaces
spv_addon.config.crawlingEyeHeight.toolt: How low the camera goes when crawling
spv_addon.config.crawlingSpeedMultiplier: Movement speed multiplier when crawling (0.3 = 30% of normal speed)
spv_addon.config.allowCrawlingInWater.to: Whether players can crawl while in water
spv_addon.config.batteryDrainRate.toolti: How fast batteries drain (1.0 = normal, 2.0 = twice as fast)
spv_addon.config.showBatteryThreshold.to: Show battery HUD when level drops below this percentage
spv_addon.config.batteryPulseEffect.tool: Make battery HUD pulse when low
spv_addon.config.batteryHealthDegradatio: Batteries lose maximum capacity over time
How fast battery health degrades (1.0 = normal)
spv_addon.config.batteryFlickerEffect.to: Flashlight flickers when battery is very low
spv_addon.config.batteryWarningSounds.to: Play sounds when battery is low
spv_addon.config.enableThirstSystem.tool: Enable thirst mechanics that drain over time
spv_addon.config.thirstDrainRate.tooltip: How fast thirst drains (1.0 = normal, only when moving, every 10 seconds)
spv_addon.config.thirstEnvironmentalMult: Thirst drains faster/slower in certain environments
spv_addon.config.thirstDamageEnabled.too: Take damage when thirst gets too low
spv_addon.config.thirstDamageAmount.tool: How much damage to take from dehydration
spv_addon.config.thirstWarningMessages.t: Show chat messages when thirst is low
spv_addon.config.thirstBiomeEffects.tool: Different biomes affect thirst drain rate
spv_addon.config.enableSanitySystem.tool: Enable sanity mechanics that drain in darkness
spv_addon.config.sanityDrainRate.tooltip: How fast sanity drains (1.0 = normal, every 7 seconds in darkness)
spv_addon.config.sanityLightRange.toolti: How close light sources need to be to prevent sanity drain
spv_addon.config.sanityEffectsEnabled.to: Enable all sanity-related visual and audio effects
spv_addon.config.sanityVisualDistortions: Screen distortions when sanity is low
spv_addon.config.sanityAudioEffects.tool: Audio distortions when sanity is low
spv_addon.config.sanityWhispers.tooltip: Hear whispers when sanity is very low
spv_addon.config.sanityScreenEffects.too: Screen effects like darkness and blur when sanity is low
spv_addon.config.sanityPhantomSounds.too: Hear fake sounds when sanity is low
gamerule.spvBatterySystem.description: Controls whether the battery system is active on the server
gamerule.spvBatteryDrainRate.description: Battery drain rate as percentage of normal (100 = normal, 50 = half speed)
gamerule.spvThirstSystem.description: Controls whether the thirst system is active on the server
gamerule.spvThirstDrainRate.description: Thirst drain rate as percentage of normal (100 = normal, 50 = half speed)
gamerule.spvThirstDamage.description: Controls whether thirst can cause damage to players
gamerule.spvSanitySystem.description: Controls whether the sanity system is active on the server
gamerule.spvSanityDrainRate.description: Sanity drain rate as percentage of normal (100 = normal, 50 = half speed)
gamerule.spvSanityEffects.description: Controls whether sanity effects (visual/audio) are enabled
